recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It is a narrow correction to the authoritative DeviceAlert StructureDefinition and event mapping-exception file, preserving the previously applied FHIR-51941 work while eliminating the isolated invalid Event.actor mapping path.
issue_request: FHIR-51941 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asked the Devices work group to address DeviceAlert and DeviceMetric workflow/FiveWs mapping exceptions by correcting resource mappings or providing rationale for justified deviations.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#3858, merged as a9dbcddfee853c4ab66ceea5995f97eb4b83a650, applied the main DeviceAlert and DeviceMetric mapping-exception updates for FHIR-51941 through source commit 01bbb9c148540bff89dd84b48b212afb3dfef0e8. A later cleanup commit e096e0eaf5bc66a35bdee31cfb007ececf819efd moved the new DeviceAlert.acknowledgedBy element but left its workflow mapping as Event.actor.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini confirms DeviceAlert and DeviceMetric are active resources. Devices minutes on 2025-10-20 and 2025-10-22 record review of the mapping exceptions and approval of FHIR-51941's structural changes. FHIR-52930 and FHIR-52931 are closely related DeviceMetric decisions from the same meetings; FHIR-52930 is already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-52931 was used only as context here.
reconciliation: Changed DeviceAlert.acknowledgedBy's workflow mapping from the invalid Event.actor path to Event.performer.actor and replaced the stale unmapped Event.performer.actor exception with a documented divergent mapping to DeviceAlert.acknowledgedBy. No DeviceMetric source change was needed for this seed because current DeviceMetric mappings and exceptions already reflect the related applied decisions.
source_changes: source/devicealert/structuredefinition-DeviceAlert.xml: changed DeviceAlert.acknowledgedBy workflow mapping from Event.actor to Event.performer.actor.
source/devicealert/devicealert-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: documented Event.performer.actor as a divergent mapping to DeviceAlert.acknowledgedBy and updated performer/function rationale.

related_jiras.note: DeviceMetric status mapping was discussed in the same Devices meetings and is already represented on the combined branch by an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit.
DeviceMetric recorded/author/version 5Ws proposals were resolved in the same mapping family; current DeviceMetric mapping exceptions carry the no-core-use-case rationale.
